source_policy.fallback_rule: GitHub/yfinance, FinMind and TAIFEX may fill null fields only when the observation belongs to the same specified trade date/session date. Never silently overwrite a non-null canonical value or use a different trade date.
source_policy.trade_date_rule: Latest completed U.S. cash session is 2026-09-04. Taiwan FX latest completed official close is 2026-09-04. TAIFEX after-hours physical window 2026-09-04 15:00–2026-09-05 05:00 is attributed to the next Taiwan futures trading session, session_trade_date 2026-09-07.
source_policy.uncertainty_rule: When exact same-session or same-instrument final data are not independently verified, retain null and flag validation_required. Different-date observations must never be blended.

breaking_news.headline: August U.S. payrolls beat expectations, pushing yields and rate-hike odds higher
breaking_news.summary: U.S. nonfarm payrolls rose 162K in August versus about 56K consensus; unemployment held at 4.1%, while June and July payrolls were revised up by a combined 55K.
breaking_news.market_impact: Treasury yields rose, rate-hike odds increased and major equity indices closed lower despite semiconductor strength.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Higher yields cap AI valuation multiples, while resilient U.S. employment supports end-demand.

breaking_news.headline: Semiconductors outperform even as broader U.S. market falls
breaking_news.summary: The PHLX semiconductor index rose about 3.4% while the S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow declined after the strong jobs report.
breaking_news.market_impact: AI/semiconductor relative strength remains intact despite a tougher rate backdrop.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Constructive for Taiwan AI/semiconductor supply chains, but follow-through must be confirmed after the long U.S. holiday weekend.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. and China prepare bilateral AI safety dialogue
breaking_news.summary: Officials are preparing a mid-September dialogue on AI safety ahead of a planned Sep 24 Trump-Xi summit.
breaking_news.market_impact: Adds a geopolitical policy channel around AI governance and technology competition.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Potentially relevant to advanced-chip export controls and cross-border AI supply chains.

breaking_news.headline: Lululemon cuts annual outlook
breaking_news.summary: Lululemon cut its 2026 revenue and profit outlook after Q2 revenue of about $2.42B and adjusted EPS of $2.06; shares fell sharply.
breaking_news.market_impact: Signals pressure in discretionary spending and company-specific execution.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Read-through is more relevant to consumer/textile suppliers than AI hardware.

breaking_news.headline: Adobe CEO transition adds uncertainty before next week's earnings
breaking_news.summary: Adobe named Anil Chakravarthy as its next CEO, with Shantanu Narayen moving to executive chair; Adobe is scheduled to report Q3 FY2026 on Sep 10.
breaking_news.market_impact: AI software execution and leadership transition become key earnings questions.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Indirect indicator for enterprise AI/software spending rather than direct hardware demand.

earnings_calendar.key_numbers: Q2 revenue ~$2.42B; adjusted EPS $2.06; 2026 EPS guide cut to $9.48-$9.73 and revenue guide to $10.35B-$10.5B; shares fell sharply.
Fiscal Q1 FY2027 results due after U.S. market close; key focus is OCI/AI cloud growth, RPO conversion and capex.
Q3 FY2026 earnings due; focus on AI monetization, Digital Media/Experience growth and CEO transition.

economic_calendar.event: Employer Costs for Employee Compensation, June 2026

narration_points: 美國8月非農新增16.2萬人，遠高於約5.6萬共識，10年債殖利率升至約4.774%，市場重新提高升息機率。
S&P 500、Nasdaq、Dow收低，但SOX逆勢上漲約3.4%，顯示半導體相對強勢沒有被利率衝擊完全破壞。
NVIDIA收230.34美元、上漲0.83%，距52週高點約2.6%；TSM ADR與AMD最終價只允許GitHub用9月4日同交易日資料補值。
WTI回落至約89.87美元、黃金期貨回檔，美元轉強；宏觀主線由AI財報重新切回就業、利率與下週通膨數據。
台股9月4日現貨大漲1.51%，但外資台指期淨空仍約8.23萬口；週五夜盤歸屬9月7日session，官方final只允許同session補值。
下週美股週一因Labor Day休市，9月10日PPI與Oracle/Adobe財報、9月11日CPI將決定利率與AI估值下一段方向。
